args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

The implementation incorrectly used ROUND_HALF_UP while claiming
round_money followed FIN-212's banker's rounding. Switch to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-way cents round to the nearest even cent,
matching tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding. This changes `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so half-way cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g., 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66), satisfying `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switched rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` passed.

⚠️ Merging into main requires code-owner approval per policy.
